name: Islamic Golden Age
description: Under the Abbasid caliphate, Baghdad's House of Wisdom translated and extended Greek, Persian, and Indian learning — algebra, optics, medicine, astronomy — while trade knit Afro-Eurasia from Córdoba to Samarkand. Conventionally closed by the Mongol sack of Baghdad.

name: High Middle Ages
description: Europe's medieval apogee: population doubling, Gothic cathedrals, the first universities, scholasticism, chartered towns, and the Crusades — before climate downturn and plague reversed the boom.
